title: Chapter 171: Recruiting Captives
content:
Chapter 171: Recruiting Captives

After this battle, Wang Shuo captured more than two hundred people. Looking at the prisoners in front of him, Wang Shuo felt worried.

Because he was very worried that the loyalty of these captives would be too low after being absorbed into the territory.

However, the development of the territory cannot be separated from the population, and Wang Shuo was caught in a dilemma.

After cleaning the battlefield, Wang Shuo obtained a large amount of equipment.

It's just that there are no energy crystals.

In the central square, Wang Shuo gathered all the prisoners.

There were more than 400 people in total, half of them were bandits and the other half were the archers and infantrymen of Fengze Village who had just been captured.

Wang Shuo was shocked when he discovered that all the captured archers and infantry were players.

Since that's the case, it's easy to handle!

He first walked to the bandit and said coldly: "Prisoners of all ranks, now I give you a chance to live, it depends on whether you cherish it or not!"

All the bandits looked at each other. Of course they didn't want to die if they could live!

These bandits are considered tool men who have initially awakened their souls, so they appear to be so greedy for life and afraid of death.

"Life is priceless. I cannot bear to have your souls fall into boundless darkness again, so I invite you to join my territory, but you must fight for the territory."

They were originally bandits, and they lived a life of licking blood every day.

At this point, it's just another master.

"Are you willing?" Wang Shuo shouted sharply.

"I do."

Someone took the lead, and the rest weakly followed.

Although Wang Shuo was not satisfied, he still nodded.

"Those who are willing to join Wana Village should stand on the left." Wang Shuo pointed to an open space on the left.

Immediately, some bandits started to act with various thoughts.

But there were still more than a dozen seemingly unruly bandits standing there without moving.

Wang Shuo didn't waste any time and directly let the dozens of arrow towers around him activate.

Random arrows shot them to death without even giving them a chance to beg for mercy.

"Now, it's your turn. Although we are all players, and I sympathize with your experience, this is the cruel reality. If you are willing to join my territory, just go to the right."

These player captives are more afraid of death than bandits.

Acting quickly, everyone stood in the open space on the right.

They were originally forced by Zhao Tianze to join Fengze Village, and were trained as archers under his force, so they had no loyalty to Zhao Tianze.

Likewise, they didn't have any strong feelings of resistance or resentment against Wang Shuo.

"Very good. Now that you have made your choice, everyone come over and sign a contract scroll!"

This scroll is naturally the same one that Wang Shuo signed with his first group of subjects.

It can only guarantee not to directly betray the territory, and there is no binding force on loyalty.

But this is already pretty good.

Every citizen who joins Wana Village, whether joining actively or passively, must recite this oath.

"I, XXX, voluntarily join Wana Village, hand over all supplies, obey the orders of Lord ID: SAC5678 Wang Shuo, and...never betray."

Only those who truly volunteer do not have to hand over all the supplies, while those who are volunteered have to confiscate all the supplies and then distribute them among the villages.

Next, everyone went to Duan Wenxi one after another to register, then took the oath and had their fingerprints pressed.
